consequence_classes.A: Stop the current run, preserve evidence, repair/reseal, and continue the overall task. Not terminal scientific FAIL by itself.
consequence_classes.B: Reject the candidate/branch only and continue legal branches. Never soften physical impossibility.
consequence_classes.C: Propagate covariance/information/weight or report uncertainty/conflict. Do not stop by itself.
consequence_classes.D: Log and continue unless a separate Class A invariant is violated.

requirements.requirement: Formal execution requires a later explicit user start command; this review package alone is not authorization.
requirements.required_evidence: explicit activation message and immutable reviewed-contract hashes

requirements.requirement: Use only the canonical Fusion_Part path; no branch, worktree, checkout copy, repository copy, or raw-data copy.
requirements.required_evidence: resolved cwd, worktree audit, write-path audit

requirements.requirement: English WORK is sole writer; Chinese monitor is strictly read-only and sends direct STEER only.
requirements.required_evidence: task IDs, host, write audit, monitor declaration

requirements.requirement: Require at least 100 GB free on /mnt/nrf_ssd, 40 GB on root, and projected growth no greater than 5 GB.
requirements.required_evidence: pre/post df and run-directory size

requirements.requirement: Never overwrite/delete/repair historical seals, reports, raw data, FAIL evidence, or prior contracts; amendments are append-only.
requirements.required_evidence: pre/post hashes and append-only manifest

requirements.requirement: Only Capture 2 is scientific input; C1/C3/Hxx/Capture3/Golf/Boxing/other captures are forbidden.
requirements.required_evidence: resolved dataset root and access log

requirements.requirement: All ten authoritative hardware IDs occur exactly once with the reviewed segment mapping; legacy alias conflicts fail closed.
requirements.required_evidence: identity table and conflict scan

requirements.requirement: Decode only raw accelerometer/gyroscope plus timing/status; forbid magnetometer, UWB spatial fields, vendor/prior quaternion, Euler pose, IK, profile, freeze, and candidate lock.
requirements.required_evidence: decoder field audit and forbidden-import scan

requirements.requirement: Before payload open/hash, create immutable run-start contract, passing validator, fresh metadata-only preselection, action allowlist, byte-access plan, and authority hashes.
requirements.required_evidence: sealed files timestamped before first payload access

requirements.requirement: Do not enumerate/open/hash/stat-for-content any holdout path to construct exclusions; holdout/00_walk, H01_boxing, and H02_golf are forbidden by default.
requirements.required_evidence: file-access trace and allowlist-only range construction

requirements.requirement: Default held-out evidence is result-independent withheld blocks within allowed C2 actions; any external holdout needs exact later authorization after fit freeze and cannot trigger refit.
requirements.required_evidence: pre-fit holdout hash/selection and fit-freeze timestamp

requirements.requirement: Bind B306 v47 direct signed-little-endian AX/AY/AZ/GX/GY/GZ register order with no permutation or sign flip.
requirements.required_evidence: firmware/source/provenance hashes and decoder unit test

requirements.requirement: Use acc=raw/2048*9.80665 m/s^2 and gyro=raw/16.384 deg/s converted to rad/s; retain gravity.
requirements.required_evidence: unit tests, still-gravity distribution, source citations

requirements.requirement: Treat JY61P accelerometer range as internally adaptive with fixed documented output convention; absence of a B306 range write is not a failure.
requirements.required_evidence: bound official protocol and saturation diagnostics

requirements.requirement: QMT quaternion storage/order/direction and every QMT-SciPy-viewer conversion pass source-level numerical round-trip before use.
requirements.required_evidence: wxyz active/passive round-trip tests

requirements.requirement: Use existing C2 gravity/bias/noise/finite/saturation checks as diagnostics and model or sensitivity-test bias drift, scale-factor/cross-axis error, quantization, correlation, timestamp jitter, gaps and duplicates; ordinary nonideality does not require new hardware tests or recapture.
requirements.required_evidence: per-node distributions, clipping/gap/duplicate counts, stochastic parameter registry and nonideal-sensor mutations

requirements.requirement: One capture-wide streaming six-axis orientation state per node; no episode-boundary VQF/QMT restart or new yaw gauge.
requirements.required_evidence: state lifecycle trace and zero reset count

requirements.requirement: Recorded timestamps are authoritative; missing rows are no-update with uncertainty, not fabricated samples or whole-capture failure.
requirements.required_evidence: gap masks, relevant-window overlap, covariance growth

requirements.requirement: Long gaps are never interpolated; interpolation is off by default and requires independent synthetic qualification and preregistration.
requirements.required_evidence: interpolation policy and synthetic mutation

requirements.requirement: Reviewed -Y/-Z directions may construct a right-handed nominal frame, but remain a broad non-compact directional distribution with uncertainty and multiple legal branches; no arbitrary numeric cone is a hard gate.
requirements.required_evidence: nominal-frame derivation, directional distribution, near-uninformative hemisphere-supported sensitivity

requirements.requirement: Only gross wrong wear hemisphere is hard rejection; exact vectors, hard mirror symmetry, and arbitrary small correction locks are forbidden.
requirements.required_evidence: branch inventory and mount-prior mutation tests

requirements.requirement: Bind pinned official QMT v0.2.4 algorithm revision and preserve official outputs, but do not treat advanced-example exact alignment, manual sign/flip/heading, ROM, start/stillness ratings, windows or solver settings as C2 truth; do not rerun a standalone one-hour bootstrap.
requirements.required_evidence: pinned revision/license, prior diagnostic attribution, and upstream-example parameter disposition table

requirements.requirement: Only after functional joint/frame inputs exist, run official headingCorrection on preregistered dense valid spans and preserve timestamped deltaFilt, corrected child quaternion, rating, state, and debug evidence; bind the equidistant-span time adapter without fabricating samples.
requirements.required_evidence: dependency trace, cadence/span selection, output hashes, ratings/states, time-variance audit

requirements.requirement: Retain QMT outputs in persistent chronological edge states and propagate the rooted nine-edge tree using official parent-plus-child delta semantics; spans are not independent profiles or gauges and a bespoke global nonlinear heading solver is not the default.
requirements.required_evidence: edge-state update trace, official-style tree propagation test, gap no-update trace, zero per-span profile count

requirements.requirement: Factors, refinement, progressive state, held-out evaluation, and viewer consume the same final time-varying corrected trajectory; never discard quat2Corr or average deltaFilt to a seed.
requirements.required_evidence: trajectory hashes at every consumer boundary

requirements.requirement: QMT row selection is preregistered, result-independent, excitation/noise/covariance aware, and distribution/effective-support audited; no desired-row cherry-picking.
requirements.required_evidence: selection rule, all selected indices, excitation/noise plots, effective sample size

requirements.requirement: All ten sensor-to-segment rotations are full SO(3) posterior states/branches estimated from C2 functional evidence under broad non-compact wear distributions; weak directions remain uncertain rather than being exactized.
requirements.required_evidence: parameter inventory, branch covariance, identifiability/broadness sensitivity, synthetic recovery

requirements.requirement: Sensor-to-joint and connection vectors occupy full 3D space; axial-on-bone scalar placement is forbidden.
requirements.required_evidence: 3D parameterization, Seel/Olsson/QMT attribution, off-axis mutations

requirements.requirement: Each knee uses its seated raise, squat, and side-matched heel-to-butt; rest alone cannot qualify an axis.
requirements.required_evidence: factor-to-episode routing and selected-row distributions

requirements.requirement: Preserve raw external anthropometry and observer disagreement; V0 does not ask IMUs to rediscover absolute bone lengths.
requirements.required_evidence: measurement provenance and used-parameter table

requirements.requirement: Do not equate external breadths/surface chords/sensor distances with internal joint-center geometry without a primary mapping and propagated uncertainty.
requirements.required_evidence: mapping citations, required inputs, uncertainty propagation

requirements.requirement: No invented torso length, hip spacing, 6 cm offset, centered sensor, hard symmetry, hidden standard adult, or zero branch spacing.
requirements.required_evidence: geometry source audit and zero/invented-geometry mutations

requirements.requirement: Bind every exact surface/sensor observation and landmark definition. Preserve the original unlabeled 260–265 mm forearm record and apply the append-only user clarification that the same range belongs to both sides; no silent midpoint, deletion of 245 mm readings, or relabeling as internal bone truth.
requirements.required_evidence: GEOMETRY_AND_PARAMETER_CONTRACT.json plus USER_ANTHROPOMETRY_AMENDMENT_001.json versus anthropometry structural comparison

requirements.requirement: Before real fit, freeze nonzero measurement-plus-landmark-mapping uncertainty without viewing residuals; absolute link length is not a free IMU-fit coordinate.
requirements.required_evidence: frozen scale likelihood/proxy derivation, raw observations, uncertainty sources, sensitivity

requirements.requirement: Explicitly preserve missing shoulder/hip centers and torso/foot geometry; bicristal is not ASIS breadth, and old 0.06 m/0.22 m/axial-offset/display constants are forbidden.
requirements.required_evidence: missingness table, primary-input audit, legacy-value non-consumption scan

requirements.requirement: Seal an ACTIVE_PARAMETER_REGISTRY before real fit; every fit, state, fixed, derived, gauge, numerical, threshold, and viewer parameter declares owner/source/unit/uncertainty/consumers/class/sensitivity.
requirements.required_evidence: registry path/hash/schema and complete parameter table

requirements.requirement: Source/config/default scan finds zero unregistered real-fit or viewer parameters; historical config values cannot enter merely because they already exist.
requirements.required_evidence: numeric-source inventory, registry join, zero-unregistered report

requirements.requirement: The connected graph is exactly a rooted nine-edge parent-child tree with one pelvis yaw gauge; official-style tree propagation is primary and no unnecessary extra global heading variables are introduced.
requirements.required_evidence: state schema, edge list, propagation equivalence and gauge-rank audit

requirements.requirement: Initial still provides only tilt, bias/noise/stillness, and impossible-branch rejection; it cannot claim yaw, axes, centers, twist, lengths, sagittal branch, or completion.
requirements.required_evidence: initial-state rank test and false-completion mutation

requirements.requirement: Maintain multiple physically legal branches until cumulative evidence prunes them.
requirements.required_evidence: branch chronology, weights, rejection causes

requirements.requirement: Apply physical feasibility before residual ranking; an invalid lower-residual candidate never displaces a legal candidate.
requirements.required_evidence: selection trace and invalid-low-cost mutation

requirements.requirement: Reject knee front/back split, crossing, mirror, disconnection, collapse, improper rotation, implausible gravity/topology and only gross ROM impossibility after subject variability/uncertainty as candidate failures; minor plausible ROM excursions are stochastic evidence.
requirements.required_evidence: physical reports, ROM uncertainty/sensitivity, images, negative mutations

requirements.requirement: One persistent chronological state retains every complete authorized episode; prefixes are posterior snapshots, not separate fits or stitched profiles.
requirements.required_evidence: episode update log, state lineage hashes, zero stitching count

requirements.requirement: Before fit freeze, progress uses gauge-reduced information/rank, uncertainty, branch concentration, physical validity, and prequential prediction scored before episode ingestion; final sealed held-out evidence is opened only after freeze and cannot trigger refit. Counts/time/iterations are forbidden and progress may decrease on conflict.
requirements.required_evidence: metric definition, prediction-before-ingest timestamps, heldout access trace, and curves including a conflict case

requirements.requirement: Covariance/information accounts for static correlation, common bias, soft-tissue artifact, and effective support; samples are not independent votes.
requirements.required_evidence: covariance model, effective sample sizes, sensitivity

requirements.requirement: Final progressive state agrees with an independently initialized fresh full chronological all-episode batch within synthetic-qualified uncertainty.
requirements.required_evidence: parameter/state/covariance comparison and tolerances

requirements.requirement: Synthetic generator is independent at model-class level and randomizes mounts/slippage, 3D offsets, human asymmetry/soft tissue/axis migration/nonideal hinges, sensor noise/bias/scale/cross-axis/drift/quantization/jitter/correlation/gaps, degeneracy, and order.
requirements.required_evidence: separate oracle dependency audit, seeds, distributions

requirements.requirement: Treat the target as integration of mature QMT/Olsson/Seel mechanisms: reference implementation and pairwise applicability map first, smallest C2 adapter second; a new bespoke solver requires a bounded proof of one missing capability and retains the mature reference comparator.
requirements.required_evidence: per-edge method/applicability table, reference-equivalence tests, adapter diff, and any missing-capability proof

requirements.requirement: All mandatory negative mutations in MASTER_CONTRACT section 12 detect/reject before first real fit.
requirements.required_evidence: mutation matrix with expected/actual outcomes

requirements.requirement: Historical failed trajectory, continuous VQF, and corrected trajectory use identical renderer, geometry, timestamps, root gauge, and cameras; historical output cannot influence fit.
requirements.required_evidence: shared-renderer hashes and isolated comparator declaration

requirements.requirement: No retarget, torso rebase, shoulder-line yaw rescue, IK, repair, smoothing rescue, per-action correction, zero shoulder/hip spacing, or invented internal geometry.
requirements.required_evidence: viewer source audit and rescue mutations

requirements.requirement: Separate sensor/segment-frame diagnostics from scientific anatomical FK; solver and viewer share corrected trajectories and qualified posterior geometry.
requirements.required_evidence: consumer hashes and geometry provenance

requirements.requirement: WORK and monitor independently inspect actual front/side/top pixels for initial, upper, both lower sides, squat, and final standing; booleans are insufficient.
requirements.required_evidence: image paths/hashes and two human inspection reports

requirements.requirement: Declare iteration/wall/multistart/worker limits before each solve; no blind call over 30 minutes or phase overrun without causal report.
requirements.required_evidence: stage budget records and convergence traces

requirements.requirement: Timeout, stall, zero candidate, mutation failure, invalid view, or local held-out conflict triggers evidence preservation, causal analysis, bounded hypothesis test, and in-scope pivot rather than task termination.
requirements.required_evidence: failure artifact, earliest divergence, test, pivot, smallest rerun

requirements.requirement: Every predicate is Class A/B/C/D before execution; no result-dependent threshold relaxation, action deletion, desired-row selection, or blind restart.
requirements.required_evidence: predicate inventory and sensitivity report

requirements.requirement: Final evidence contains all hashes, access audit, code/tests, synthetic results, stage traces, parameters/uncertainty, progressive curves, batch comparison, conflicts/pivots, images/pixel findings, and disk growth.
requirements.required_evidence: final manifest and report

requirements.requirement: PASS requires every obligation; INCONCLUSIVE names unresolved evidence; scientific FAIL requires a valid qualified pipeline. Implementation failure/timeout/bad viewer is never terminal scientific FAIL.
requirements.required_evidence: verdict-to-evidence matrix
